steps.name: Father
steps.text: A small sandbeast in the forest caught my attention. My knowledge told me that this creature usually makes its habitat in the barrens.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: The frightened beast escaped into the bushes. I pursued it through thorn and briar, driven by curiosity, and found myself gazing upon an unexpected landscape...

steps.name: Father
steps.text: Do you see it, Fenny?

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: The great desert and the sky, pink where they meet on the horizon. It's totally different from the pictures in the textbooks.

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: It smells sweet.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: Heh, that's your mom baking cupcakes. They'll be ready soon.

steps.name: Daughter
steps.text: Tell me again about your adventures in the eastern wasteland... no, tell me about the city in the sky!

steps.name: Father
steps.text: There's no rush, Fenny. We have plenty of time, and plenty of adventures to talk about.

steps.name: Father
steps.text: You'll see everything that I've ever seen, when you grow up and your feet become quicker, I promise.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Stop spinning tall tales to my clients!

steps.name: Martin Barn
steps.text: Don't blame me for you being boring, trainee. They like my stories better.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: My job is to take clients to see places that actually exist.

steps.name: Martin Barn
steps.text: You think only the places that your company marked exist? What about the things I saw in my youth?

steps.name: Martin Barn
steps.text: I told you, you shouldn't just read from your tourist manual. You need to walk a path that no one has ever seen—

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: And achieve nothing in life, get laughed at by the neighbors, and spend my old age spinning tall tales to children?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: I believed your stories—the flying beckbeast, floating city, golden-pink deserts... they'll always be precious memories.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: But you believe in your stories too much.

steps.name: Martin Barn
steps.text: Ferne! *cough* Come back here!

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Congratulations, Miss Ferne Barn. Your application has been approved. You are now the owner of an independent travel agency.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Thank you. It's a big first step, even if it's a one-woman company!

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: One woman? I thought there was another name on the application...?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Martin Barn, my dad. Passed away last year.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: No need to apologize. I wouldn't have decided to start my own travel agency, if not for him.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Even if we won't be able to travel together, Martin Barn will always be an important part of this company.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: I'm sure he'd be glad. Have you decided your first route? I can recommend a few popular spots.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Hm... is there someplace that no one's ever gone before?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Most of my peers think my slogan of going into the unknown is just a gimmick. Only my clients and I know how many wonderful sights we saw, and how many amazing things we did together.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Our destination was Propeller Paradise. I wanted to see what the future would be like, while my client had an ambiguous wish.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: I swear I didn't mean to sabotage Rhine... my client wasn't in good shape, and you were the only other Banshee I knew of—

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: No need to apologize. I'm not here to put you on trial. I just wanted to know who you and your client were.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I'll be happy to read your autobiography, if you ever publish one. But right now, time is of the essence.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You're worried about the hearing? I don't think the investigation is complete yet, since they keep pushing the date back.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The trial will come sooner than you think.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Tell me about your Banshee client, as succinctly as you can. When did you meet? Why did you come here? And... how is her health?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: It was two months ago, in the Bleached Wasteland...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Brrr... it's really cold at night. The sand's black, completely different from what dad said.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: The outskirts of the Bleached Wasteland aren't as scary as the stories say. My flesh hasn't been ripped from my bones, and I haven't heard the ghosts of the dead wailing.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Wait, what's that shadow on the slope? Don't tell me there actually are ghosts here...

spans.text: Wait, what's that shadow on the slope? Don't tell me there actually

steps.name: Feeble Banshee
steps.text: Is this... Columbia?

steps.name: Feeble Banshee
steps.text: 'Guide.'

steps.name: Feeble Banshee
steps.text: Gui-*cough*... guide...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Are you alright?!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Pulse and breathing, normal. Doesn't seem like dehydration... well, can't hurt to try.

steps.name: Feeble Banshee
steps.text: Am I... back in the Convallis?

steps.name: Feeble Banshee
steps.text: No... I haven't seen her yet... do not mourn me... I must not roost...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Calm down. Do you remember your name?

steps.name: Feeble Banshee
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You're in the Bleached Wasteland, in Columbia. Do you remember what you're here for?

steps.name: Feeble Banshee
steps.text: Wasteland...?

steps.name: Feeble Banshee
steps.text: No... she's not here...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: What are you looking for? Maybe I can help. Ferne's Tours will fulfill your every wish, even the ones you think won't come true, and our prices are fair and reasonable!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: My dad always said that if it hasn't come true yet, there's always a chance. He also said... ma'am? Ma'am!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: She's lost consciousness. Feather horns... what's this Banshee looking for, and how did she get lost in the Bleached Wasteland?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: What are these floating symbols? What language is this? And these golden patterns carrying tiny leaves... is this her Arts?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: The leaves are moving... pointing towards D.C.?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Her memory got fuzzier and fuzzier. I didn't know what was wrong with her and I got desperate.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You can't stop time.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: It's a symptom of age? But her memories...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I've seen this before in the Convallis. It goes hand-in-hand with death.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: If a Banshee who's starting to lose her memory showed up here, then perhaps...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: It's her last wish to keep what's left of her mind together.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Do you mean...?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You're trying to fulfill her dying wish.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: She came all the way to Columbia, walked through the Bleached Wasteland on foot, just to fulfill her final wish?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: What is she looking for? An object, a truth, or someone she cared about?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Every cop on Propeller Paradise is looking for you. Rhine needs to give everyone an explanation.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: This delayed hearing is extremely important to you, yet you came to look for a guide you've only met in passing, asking about her client...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Unless you already know who she's looking for, or—

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Is it you she came to Columbia for?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Thank you for caring for my mother, Ferne.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: She must still be somewhere on Propeller Paradise! I'll help you look for her!

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: We're out of time.
Please come with us, Director Lunorey.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: A few more minutes, please... wait, your uniform... it's not Tannen who sent you.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The Maylander Emergency Management Council? Your new uniforms look just like the old ones.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: The Council has completed its investigation concerning the flight of the illegal device that occurred last night. Please accompany us to verify the findings.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: Please communicate any objections that you may have, to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings and waste of time at the hearing.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: The investigation is complete... then why hasn't the hearing started? We've been waiting for seven hours!

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The hearing is delayed, but the trial has already begun.

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: I can understand if a scientist doesn't like to talk. Have YOU forgotten how to speak too?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I remember how I was on the shortlist for promotion. The next day, you transferred an official of the same rank over from HQ.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: He was young, superb... made all the candidates uneasy. We climbed over each other to prove to you that we were the best one for the job.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Same old story, isn't it?

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: In the end, you were the one who got the promotion.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I was supposed to get it!

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: Nothing is ever 'supposed' to happen, kid.

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: You really think the chief executive of Propeller Paradise is an important post? No, people will only remember the one who gives the opening address.

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: It doesn't necessarily have to be you.
Gordon has his eyes on the Kuranta behind Gustave. The spikes on the Savra's tail rise up on their ends, swaying conspicuously. He is on guard.
He knows that Gustave is intentionally agitating his competitiveness, but after so many years at ATAO, he just can't stop himself from provoking his competitors.
In order to leave ATAO, he took on tasks that were not his job, pulled strings everywhere, and bowed his head to Gustave, his tormentor.
He must not stop now.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: What do you think Rhine's device is, Mr. Consultant?

steps.name: Scientific Consultant
steps.text: Mm. Maybe a variation of a floating botanical unit?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Excuses—

steps.name: Scientific Consultant
steps.text: No, no. Floating botanical units are electrical cables in the sky. Light weight and mobility are paramount.

steps.name: Scientific Consultant
steps.text: What did I see on my way here...? Two empty slots on the tree's internal activator.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: My guess is—

steps.name: Scientific Consultant
steps.text: Oh, anyone can tell it's waiting for two 'keys'.

steps.name: Scientific Consultant
steps.text: It doesn't look like the tree will fully activate until a second Rhine Lab section director is present. Unless someone else sneaks into Propeller Paradise unnoticed...

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Scientific Consultant
steps.text: People might have many theories and speculations about this device because of its appearance and the Rhine name, but I see nothing more than a flying 'tree', Mr. Gustave.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Are you done? We're not here to write Rhine's paper for them.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: The delayed hearing has bought us time. But the reason Nasti concealed the tree's existence, how Ferne sneaked in, and my side hustle... everything needs an explanation.

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: Enough. Impatience is a sign of fear, and questions are a sign of incompetence.

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: Our consultant here has already given us the answer.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: Rhine's device is pretty low-risk, but also invites all kinds of speculation. Therefore, our definition of it can be as big or as small as we want it to be.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: What else do you need me to do, sir?

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: Do as you're told.

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: All you need to do is what you're told.

steps.name: Company Representative
steps.text: Stop pushing!

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: P-Please, let me through, I have something to ask the desk...

steps.name: Company Representative
steps.text: Don't waste your time. They don't know when the hearing is.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I just want to know if I should come forward to the investigation...

steps.name: Company Representative
steps.text: Listen, we're impatient too. No one can do anything to move the hearing process forward, unless you're actually involved in the case.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Company Representative
steps.text: Let me guess. You took out a 'Sky Loan', didn't you?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Yes... there were six grocers like me back home. We spent our days betting drinks on the direction that tumbleweed rolled, until two years ago...

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: The sky, the Starpod, life free of Originium, a brand-new frontier for Columbia... I didn't understand a thing that the TV and newspapers said, but I saw the light that night.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I sold my shop, abandoned my wife, took out a huge loan, and went into Propeller Paradise without ever looking back.

steps.name: Company Representative
steps.text: I've already heard a dozen stories like that today. Take a banner and go join the protest instead of hanging your head here.

a.text: Aspen looks down at the protest banner in his hand. The fabric is silver, a reflective material commonly used by flying machines.
Lucky Cystybeast's furniture uses the same materials too. Aspen does not understand how it became so popular so quickly. The sofa reflects his face whenever he walks past it. It is patently absurd.
Yet the sight of the silvery fabric also causes his heart to leap, as though the future is really in his hands, and luck is really on his side.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I'll make it... I'll make it through this hearing.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Even if I'm put on trial and thrown in jail, I'll make sure the name Lucky Cystybeast and my exhibits stay on Propeller Paradise, where everybody can see them.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Things will turn out fine. Lucky Cystybeast will bring me luck!

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: He's never been late before... was he delayed by the protests, or did he get lost on the way?
The structure of Propeller Paradise is certainly complex, but it's not so hard to understand if we see it as a massive Wrankwood film set.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I remember the pioneer-era classics that you starred in. People still think your metal body was some kind of special effect.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: You have a good memory.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Transportation on the levitating layer is very interesting. The combination of steel wires and ball pods seems like some sort of amusement park.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: I apologize for the delay. I had to make a few rounds to humor these three stooges.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I haven't had a chance to greet them yet.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: No need to be nervous. Young Maylander agents always attract too much attention. It takes someone with a calmer demeanor like you to play the part of a secretary. But I can't help but feel like you're starting to go too far with this seriousness thing.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Tannen isn't an easy customer, is he?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: He has... a personality. It's not hard to read.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Your timing a few days ago was impeccable. A single squad eliminated two major risks before the exhibition. I'll be sure to make a note on your annual assessment.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I'm flattered.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: The suspension of Propeller Paradise's administrative and engineering functions has created plenty of room for Maylander to operate.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Gustave's desire to work with us is clear. He has already sent people to deal with Rhine's devices, and he intends to personally instruct his subordinates.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I guess all that's left is a hearing to placate the public?

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: You have questions about the delay of the hearing, don't you?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: It's not like Maylander to stall.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Since when did you pick up an impatient streak? Everything happens in due course. We're not only here to investigate.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Such a beautiful, futuristic city. I leave Columbia for a few months, and all sorts of new stuff pop up.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: How long will it take to make a full round of the levitation layer?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Less than an hour by ropeway.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Very good. I would like to enjoy a nice view of Propeller Paradise before the hearing.
